显示仓库访问令牌明文: Show Repository Access Token in Plain Text
普通信息使用列表行和分隔线；只突出异常、选中项和主要动作。: Use list rows and dividers for ordinary information; highlight only exceptions, selections, and primary actions.
有 %lld 个片段的向量缺失、维度不匹配或指向旧版本。: %lld excerpts have missing vectors, mismatched dimensions, or point to an older version.
未启用来源、作者或标签筛选: No Source, Author, or Tag Filters Enabled
本地工作区没有未提交改动。: There are no uncommitted changes in the local workspace.
标题 %@ 字符，建议不超过 %lld 字符。描述 %@ 字符，建议不超过 %l: Title: %@ characters (recommended maximum %lld). Description: %@ characters (recommended maximum %lld).
检查网络后重试。: Check your network connection and try again.
模板文件请使用本地站点预览。: Use Local Site Preview for template files.
正在保存恢复前数据并准备恢复…: Saving pre-restore data and preparing restoration…
正在读取本机网页归档并生成修复预览…: Reading local web archive and generating a repair preview…
正文内容一致，但会升级解析器并重新生成全文和本地语义索引。: The body is unchanged, but the parser will be upgraded and the full text and local semantic index regenerated.
正文有缺失、混入导航或网页页脚时，可以使用本机原始归档重新净化。: If the body is incomplete or includes navigation or a page footer, sanitize it again from the local original archive.
此服务已获授权，但远程 AI 总闸已关闭；重新开启后会恢复。: This service is authorized, but the remote AI master switch is off. It will resume when re-enabled.
此目的地曾获授权，但远程 AI 总闸已关闭；当前不会发送内容。: This destination was authorized, but the remote AI master switch is off. No content will be sent now.
每次再显示最多 %lld 篇文章: Show up to %lld more articles at a time
清理 %lld 天前的历史文章: Clean Up Articles Older Than %lld Days
清理操作会把选中项移入 macOS 废纸篓，不会永久删除。: Cleanup moves selected items to the macOS Trash and does not delete them permanently.
清除搜索条件后查看全部文件。: Clear search criteria to view all files.
点击“完成合并并提交”，真正退出 MERGING 状态。: Click “Complete Merge and Commit” to exit the MERGING state.
点击“继续变基”；下一批冲突仍会留在软件内处理。: Click “Continue Rebase”; the next batch of conflicts will remain available to resolve in the app.
点击切换为单行横向微滚动模式: Click to switch to single-line horizontal micro-scrolling
点击切换为长行自动换行模式: Click to switch to long-line wrapping
站内未检测到旧引用；仍可保留旧地址，承接搜索引擎和站外来路。: No outdated references were found on this site. You can still keep the old URL for search engines and external links.
第 %lld 行不是有效的键值格式。: Line %lld is not in a valid key-value format.
纯 HTML 可直接系统预览；请先保存更改。: Pure HTML can be previewed in the system browser; save your changes first.
继续写几句正文，或在资料库中导入网页、Markdown、PDF 和摘录。: Keep writing, or import web pages, Markdown, PDFs, and excerpts into the research library.
订阅有效，目前没有文章: The Feed Is Valid but Has No Articles Yet
该 RSS / Atom 已成功读取，只是尚未发布条目。: This RSS / Atom feed was read successfully, but it has not published any items yet.
请先在编辑区确认是否放弃未保存更改。: First confirm in the editor whether to discard unsaved changes.
请清除部分条件，或将搜索范围扩大到全部站点。: Clear some criteria or expand the search to the entire site.
请逐个处理当前变基冲突，恢复 stash 将持续保留。: Resolve the current rebase conflicts one at a time; the recovery stash will remain available.
请逐个审阅最终版本并暂存，全部完成后再提交合并。: Review and stage each final version, then commit the merge when all are complete.
请重新检查资料库。: Please check the research library again.
调整界面控件的紧凑程度。: Adjust the compactness of interface controls.
软件已停止自动写入，请检查仓库操作标记。: The app has stopped automatic writes. Check the repository operation markers.
输入关键词搜索文章。搜索标题、摘要、正文和元数据，或组合结构化条件；保存的查询可: Enter keywords to search articles. Search titles, summaries, content, and metadata, or combine structured criteria; reload saved searches beside the search scope.
还没有可用于本地关联的资料: No Sources Available for Local Linking Yet
还没有可用的只读访问令牌。: No read-only access token is available yet.
这些图片或附件目前没有被任何仓库 Markdown 引用；勾选后可移入废纸篓。: These images or attachments are not referenced by any repository Markdown file. Select them to move them to the Trash.
这些路径在 upstream 也有变更，合并前需要审阅远端 diff。: These paths also changed upstream; review the remote diff before merging.
这是恢复 stash 时的冲突，不存在安全的通用 continue/abort。: This is a conflict while restoring a stash; there is no safe general continue or abort action.
远程 AI 总闸已关闭；当前不会向 ChatGPT 发送内容。: The remote AI master switch is off; no content will be sent to ChatGPT now.
远程 AI 总闸已关闭；当前不会向此服务发送内容。: The remote AI master switch is off; no content will be sent to this service now.
选择一种方式建立第一篇内容。: Choose a way to create your first piece of content.
选择应用中按钮、链接等高亮元素的颜色。: Choose the color of highlighted elements such as buttons and links in the app.
